scope: File raw-byte identity, deterministic directory snapshots, static URL descriptors and explicit asset selection.
Tamper/restore, path escape, symlink/junction refusal, bounded input and failure controls on small synthetic fixtures.
Filesystem-root requests rejected before filesystem access; source/final-slot overlap refused before directory creation; legitimate sibling snapshots remain supported.
limitations: Not connected to project_state, Manager, workflow or report input dispatch.
URL descriptor identity does not verify remote content or network behavior.
No domain inference, large-scale performance, volume remapping or complete concurrent filesystem/ABA proof.
Platform observations are from the current Windows host; other operating systems are not accepted by this record.
